parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory tree — a sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. The other record is a production method in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`). Merging or extracting the shared `DebugMetricsProvider.setUpTimers` implementation would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to demonstration-context semantics. The duplication is intentional: the sample app replicates the method locally to remain self-contained without taking a hard dependency on the `DebugPanel` package.
